gates.label: Untouched prediction and alert performance
gates.evidence: Frozen North 2023–2024 evaluation: 1,014 evaluable windows; 6.84% lower mean absolute log1p error. The paired error-gain 95% interval is [0.001650, 0.017389]. Improvement is positive in both years. Historical corrected archives do not establish live as-issued performance.
gates.decision: Use as bounded North prediction evidence. Better monitoring allocation and transfer require separate evidence.

gates.label: Monitoring allocation and cost trade-off
gates.evidence: North selected model: 46 proposed slots, comprising 25 known high windows, 19 known non-high windows and 2 unknown outcomes. Baseline: 38 slots, comprising 26 high and 12 non-high windows. Different true-alert sets have different observed peak-time leads; a paired lead improvement is not established.
gates.decision: Do not promote either learned policy as commercially superior. The supplementary Glenwood classifier identified 8 high windows using 10 proposed slots versus 6 using 8 baseline slots; its joint no-more-spend and precision-superiority gate failed.

gates.label: Untouched decision-objective validation
gates.evidence: Glenwood 2024–2025: 1,510 evaluable windows, 20 high windows above the frozen 126 FNU threshold. Classifier: 10 slots, 8 high, 2 non-high. Baseline: 8 slots, 6 high, 2 non-high. No accepted outcome is unknown. Precision gain 5 percentage points; paired 95% interval [0, 13.33] percentage points.
gates.decision: The classifier fails the no-more-spend criterion and strict positive precision-interval criterion. Preserve the baseline and classifier as historical comparisons; prospective deployment needs a separately accepted policy.

gates.label: Portability to another watershed
gates.evidence: The North-trained state model increased East log1p error by 0.014971 across 1,481 windows. The paired gain 95% interval is [−0.026820, −0.003974].
gates.decision: Require local validation before cross-watershed deployment.

gates.label: Live data availability and service reliability
gates.evidence: Historical approved archives and a declared 30-minute release-latency assumption; observed release timing is unavailable.
gates.decision: A live service-level promise needs release-time telemetry and monitored operation

finance_evidence_ledger.source_reuse: NorthernWater public automated retrieval permission does not imply unrestricted raw redistribution. Public release includes derived QA and source links, not its native bulk observations. USGS forecast evidence retains attribution.
finance_evidence_ledger.interpretation: The desk produces traceable historical monitoring proposals and investment evidence records. North point accuracy improved modestly, its monitoring policy did not demonstrate superiority, and East transfer failed. The separate Glenwood classifier identified more high windows with more proposed slots, but failed its frozen joint business criteria. Sales demand, treatment benefits, a live operational service level and financial returns remain unvalidated.

title: North Inlet · six-hour peak forecasts
summary: North mean absolute log1p(FNU) error was 6.84% lower on 1,014 untouched-test windows. The learned monitoring rule used 46 proposed slots versus 38 and found 25 known high windows versus 26. Monitoring superiority was not established; East transfer failed.

monitoring_policy.policy_description: Each model uses its development-frozen threshold targeting at most 10% candidate alerts. First strict crossing per station/UTC day receives one proposed slot before future outcome coverage is known; later candidates are suppressed.

conclusion.headline: A modest North accuracy gain; learned monitoring promotion is not supported.
limitations: Paired log-error gain 0.010169, 95% interval [0.001650, 0.017389]; both test years improved.
Current-state baseline proposed 38 windows: 26 known high and 12 false alerts. Selected model proposed 46: 25 known high, 19 false and 2 unknown outcomes.
East transfer increased log error: paired gain −0.014971, 95% interval [−0.026820, −0.003974].
No live service, treatment effect, ROI or intervention rank established.
